intent: Complete V9.0-A3 evidence-native semantic understanding bootstrap
observations: RAIOS can now represent claims separately from evidence and implementation.
Historical and current evidence are classified separately.
Contradictory claims become explicit unresolved contradiction objects.
Capability maturity is evidence-bounded and does not infer runtime or production success from artifact presence.
lesson: Semantic understanding is the controlled transformation of observations into bounded claims and evidence relationships, not free-form inference.
RAIOS should abstain at the strongest maturity level that evidence actually supports.
